title: Roommate, partial info: man 45 very drowsy, slurring, empty bottle of sleeping pills

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what's the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 3380 Mission Street, apartment 6. My roommate, Kevin, I can barely wake him up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, but slow, like really slow and kind of snory. When I shake him he opens his eyes and mumbles and his words are all slurred, then he drifts off again.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There's an empty bottle of his sleeping pills on the nightstand. It was half full yesterday, I think. Maybe he took some of his Xanax too, I'm not sure.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When did you last see him acting normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I talked to him at like eight, he was fine, a bit down, he said he was going to bed early.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Keep him on his side and keep checking his breathing.
